title: Among patients diagnosed with SJS who have had at least two laboratory test
question: Among patients diagnosed with SJS who have had at least two laboratory tests showing abnormal anti-SSA results, how many are male versus female? Return 'True' if there are more males, otherwise 'False'.

prediction.sql:
WITH AbnormalSSA AS (
    SELECT L."XCL_014" AS patient_id
    FROM Laboratory L
    WHERE L."XCL_053" NOT IN ('0', 'negative')
      AND L."XCL_053" IS NOT NULL
),
Qualifying AS (
    SELECT P."XCL_058"
    FROM Patient P
    INNER JOIN AbnormalSSA A ON P."XCL_058" = A.patient_id
    WHERE P."XCL_064" = 'SJS'
    GROUP BY P."XCL_058"
    HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2
)
SELECT CASE
         WHEN (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Patient P WHERE P."XCL_058" IN (SELECT "XCL_058" FROM Qualifying) AND P."XCL_059" = 'M')
            > (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Patient P WHERE P."XCL_058" IN (SELECT "XCL_058" FROM Qualifying) AND P."XCL_059" = 'F')
         THEN 'True' ELSE 'False'
       END

    SELECT L."XCL_014" AS patient_id
    FROM Laboratory L
    WHERE L."XCL_053" NOT IN ('0', 'negative')
      AND L."XCL_053" IS NOT NULL
),
Qualifying AS (
    SELECT P."XCL_058"
    FROM Patient P
    INNER JOIN AbnormalSSA A ON P."XCL_058" = A.patient_id
    WHERE P."XCL_064" = 'SJS'
    GROUP BY P."XCL_058"
    HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2
)
SELECT CASE
         WHEN (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Patient P WHERE P."XCL_058" IN (SELECT "XCL_058" FROM Qualifying) AND P."XCL_059" = 'M')
            > (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Patient P WHERE P."XCL_058" IN (SELECT "XCL_058" FROM Qualifying) AND P."XCL_059" = 'F')
         THEN 'True' ELSE 'False'
       END

base_solution_anchor.base_sql:
WITH Qualifying AS (
    SELECT P."XCL_058"
    FROM Patient P
    JOIN Laboratory L ON P."XCL_058" = L."XCL_014"
    WHERE P."XCL_064" = 'SJS'
      AND L."XCL_052" LIKE '%SSA%'
      AND L."XCL_053" IN ('+', '2+', '3+')
    GROUP BY P."XCL_058"
    HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2
)
SELECT CASE
         WHEN (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Patient P WHERE P."XCL_058" IN (SELECT "XCL_058" FROM Qualifying) AND P."XCL_059" = 'M')
            > (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Patient P WHERE P."XCL_058" IN (SELECT "XCL_058" FROM Qualifying) AND P."XCL_059" = 'F')
         THEN 'True' ELSE 'False'
       END

WITH sjs_patients AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT e.XCL_001 AS patient_id
    FROM Examination e
    WHERE e.XCL_009 = 'SJS'
),
abnormal_anti_ssa AS (
    SELECT l.XCL_014 AS patient_id, COUNT(*) AS abnormal_count
    FROM Laboratory l
    WHERE l.XCL_041 = 'Abnormal'
      AND l.XCL_045 = 'Anti-SSA'
    GROUP BY l.XCL_014
    HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2
),
target_patients AS (
    SELECT sp.patient_id
    FROM sjs_patients sp
    INNER JOIN abnormal_anti_ssa aas ON sp.patient_id = aas.patient_id
),
gender_counts AS (
    SELECT 
        CASE 
            WHEN p.XCL_063 = 'M' THEN 'Male'
            WHEN p.XCL_063 = 'F' THEN 'Female'
            ELSE 'Other'
        END AS gender,
        COUNT(*) AS cnt
    FROM target_patients tp
    INNER JOIN Patient p ON tp.patient_id = p.XCL_058
    GROUP BY p.XCL_063
)
SELECT 
    CASE 
        WHEN (SELECT cnt FROM gender_counts WHERE gender = 'Male') > (SELECT cnt FROM gender_counts WHERE gender = 'Female') 
        THEN 'True' 
        ELSE 'False' 
    END AS result
FROM (SELECT 1) AS dummy
